name: EPIC 220311957
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 10.3 solar radii and 0.94 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220311957 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.257162 (16th-84th percentiles 9.996342-10.536523), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220311957: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4724.745 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220311957 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3782.421875 (16th-84th percentiles 3713.671875-3854.0625), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.11 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,782 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.94 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,725 K at its surface.
